mostWorthwhile.text: Building the epidermal barrier was most worthwhile: the planned picture and explanation connect lipids with reduced water loss and deeper cells with surface renewal.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to join the epidermis directly to connective tissue was confusing because the need to add vessels first was not apparent from the initial descriptions.

surprise.text: I expected the two skin layers to join immediately; inspecting the connective tissue revealed that its available partner was first the blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: Requiring the dermis to be vascularised before layering felt somewhat arbitrary, although the resulting skin's vessels have a clear nourishing role.

continue.text: I would continue: connecting the protective barrier, vessels and sensory endings to the body made the construction feel purposeful, despite the hidden ordering constraint.
